reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E011 as a 'key held too long' fault in its first reply, named moisture/cleaning residue as a cause, and gave the right sequence (dry panel, check for obstructions, isolate at the cooker switch for a few minutes) plus sensible escalation to Bosch only if the code recurs with a dry panel.
